purpose: Validate an independently implemented direct response-array calculation against CIAO addresp on untouched deterministic suffix controls before any full response successor is frozen.

reference.exposure_source: the linked source PHA EXPOSURE, matching combine_spectra exp_origin=pha
reference.exploratory_disclosure: The formulas were reconstructed on the two registered regions and two 64-cell manifest prefixes after V19DG2 failed. Those controls are excluded here. V19DH uses only the last 128 cells of each cluster and was frozen before their direct-versus-array results were computed.

decision.pass: Both suffix controls preserve the energy grid, ARF to 1e-6 relative, every dense RMF element below CIAO's 1e-6 truncation difference, RMF row sums within 1e-4, and four forward-folded spectra within 1e-5 L1. A separately named direct-array output writer and full combination successor may be frozen.
decision.fail: Do not create a direct-array full successor. Retire this response reconstruction and choose a joint-likelihood or another independently derived method.

claim_boundary: V19DH validates response arithmetic only; it does not construct a terminal integrated or regional response.
No spectrum is fitted and no temperature, source invariant, lensing, halo, action, gravity parameter or holdout result is opened.
The failed hierarchical method remains rejected even if this independent direct-array method passes.
A pass authorizes a separately hash-frozen writer/successor and is not itself a scientific source result.
